column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_deck.prx (see re/documented.tsv for the columns; registry ids carry the module prefix, addresses here do not).

column3: summary

Allocates the arrays of an editor list from heap *0x08ebf188 using the capacity u16 at 0x08ebd234 + 2 x kind: an entry array of capacity x 6 bytes at list +4 and a view array of capacity x 2 bytes at list +0x10 (nothing when the capacity is 0). Side effects: heap allocations, list +4, +0x10. Callers: 1 (deck_init_editor_lists).

Builds the deck editor lists: for another owner's deck loads the slot's recipe into 0x08ebee20; for each list kind with a builder in the table at 0x08ebd21c allocates its arrays, stores the kind, fills it with the builder, updates totals and the view and sorts it; then makes list 4 an alias of list 2, resets the trunk view, counts frames and flags the owner's recipe cards. Side effects: editor lists 0x08ebed00-0x08ebedbf, heap. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_init_state).

Trunk builder: for ids 0xe88-0x1f39 computes the free copies (own deck: deck_count_free_card_copies_2; another owner's: deck_get_other_deck_free_copies(slot, id, 0x08ebee20)) and adds an entry with that many copies for valid cards with free copies > 0; counts the ids with owned copies (or allowance) > 0 in 0x08ebee0e. Returns the entry count. Side effects: list arrays, 0x08ebee0e. No direct caller (builder table 0x08ebd21c).

Extra-deck builder: one entry (copies 1, flags cleared, image index) per card of list 3 of the edited slot; for the player's own deck, each save card-list entry with state 3 sets flag 0x80 of byte 4 on the last matching entry that lacks it. Returns the entry count. Side effects: list arrays. No direct caller (builder table 0x08ebd21c).

List builder: unless another owner's deck is edited, adds one entry per save card-list entry whose state is not 1, 2 or 3 (id, image index from ui_find_card_image_index with resource 0x8031, copies 1 with flag 0x80, byte 5 bits 0, 5, 6 cleared) and its view index; returns the entry count. Side effects: list arrays. No direct caller (builder table 0x08ebd21c).

Makes dst an alias of editor list src: when realloc_view is set, frees dst's view array (+0x10) and allocates a new 0x28-byte one from the editor heap *0x08ebf188; copies the entry-array pointer (+4, shared, not duplicated), entry count (+8) and view count (+0x14), and memcpy's view-count x 2 bytes of view indices. Side effects: dst, heap. Callers: 2 (deck_init_editor_lists, deck_reload_editor_lists).

For the six editor lists at 0x08ebed00 (0x20 bytes each) frees the view array (+0x10) and, except for list 4 whose entries are shared with list 2, the entry array (+4) on heap *0x08ebf188, clearing the pointers. Side effects: heap frees, list pointers. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_scene_exit).

Returns the index of the first entry (6 bytes each, array at list +4, count u16 at +8) whose id equals card_id, or -1. No side effects. Callers: 4 (deck_get_list_view_position, deck_add_list_entry, deck_return_deck_cards_to_trunk, deck_load_deck_into_editor).

column2: short deck_count_list_copies(void *list, int card_id, int same_name)
column3: Sums the copies (entry byte 4 & 0x7f) of the editor list's entries with id card_id and, when same_name is set, also of entries that card_db_is_same_name matches. No side effects. Callers: 4 (deck_start_card_transfer, deck_start_card_move, deck_check_deck_legality, ui_draw_card_row_detailed).

Sums the copies (entry byte 4 & 0x7f) of every entry of the editor list with id card_id into *out_count; returns 1 when any of them has flag 0x80 in byte 4, else 0. Side effects: *out_count. Callers: 3 (deck_get_card_sort_key, deck_get_card_group_key, ui_draw_card_row_detailed).
Counts the entries (not copies) of editor lists 0 (main), 2 (side) and 1 (extra) whose deck_get_card_limit(deck_is_editing_other_deck(), id) is 0. No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_start_card_move).

Removes one copy of entry index: returns 0 for an index outside the list; with 2 or more copies decrements them; otherwise deletes the entry (shifts the array, drops it from the view and renumbers higher view indices, mirrored on the other of lists 2/4 which share the entries); updates totals and returns 1. Side effects: list arrays, view, totals. Callers: 2 (deck_load_deck_into_editor, deck_remove_card_move_source).

Adds a 6-byte entry to an editor list: in the trunk an existing id gets the copies added (and byte 5 bit 0 OR-ed); otherwise the entry is appended, its key flag cleared for kinds 1, 3, 5 or copied from an existing entry of the same id; the view gets the index via deck_insert_view_index(list, index, pos) and totals are updated; lists 2 and 4 (shared entries) also update the other list's count and view. Side effects: list arrays, view, totals. Callers: 3 (deck_load_deck_into_editor, deck_drop_card_move, deck_update_card_move).

column2: void deck_insert_view_index(void *list, int index, int pos)
column3: Rebuilds the view array (+0x10, count +0x14) with entry index placed at view position pos: copies the old view in order, keeping an existing occurrence of index when pos < 0 or pos <= count and dropping it otherwise, inserts index when the output position reaches pos, and appends it if it was neither kept nor inserted. Side effects: list view, temporary heap use. Callers: 1 (deck_add_list_entry).

Clears the 7 u16 counters at 0x08ebee10 and counts the entries (not copies) of editor list 0 (main) and list 1 (extra) per frame category (deck_get_frame_category(card_db_get_frame(id)), negatives skipped). Side effects: 0x08ebee10-0x08ebee1d. Callers: 5 (deck_init_editor_lists, deck_return_deck_cards_to_trunk, deck_load_deck_into_editor, deck_finish_card_move, ...).

Rebuilds every editor list with its builder from the table at 0x08ebd21c (totals, view, sort, cleared scroll fields), resets the trunk view, re-aliases list 4 to list 2, recounts frames, re-flags the owner's recipe cards, clears the pane cursors and, for slot 1, reloads the deck name into 0x08ebedc0. Side effects: editor lists and cursors. Callers: 1 (ui_handle_deck_options_submenu).

Recomputes the total copies of an editor list: list +0xc = sum of (entry byte 4 & 0x7f) over the entries (array +4, count +8). Side effects: list +0xc. Callers: 5 (deck_init_editor_lists, deck_add_list_entry, deck_return_deck_cards_to_trunk, deck_remove_list_entry, ...).

For 0 <= index < 50, writes the editor deck into stored deck record index (save_get_stored_deck): main (list 0), side (list 2) and extra (list 1) ids and counts into the 0xc0-byte deck at +0x54, key-flagged cards into the key-card list +0x114 (deck_add_key_card_unique), the name 0x08ebedc0 into +4, calls the import stub 0x08eb81b8 with record +0x44 and sets the flag +0 = 1. Side effects: that stored deck record. No direct caller.

For slots other than 0, 1 and 0x2e, marks the editor entries that come from the owner's recipe: deck_flag_all_recipe_cards(slot) when slot is 0x1b or world_get_character_category is neither 0 nor 2, else deck_flag_listed_recipe_cards(slot). Side effects: flag bit 6 of entry byte 5 in lists 0 and 1. Callers: 3 (deck_init_editor_lists, deck_reload_editor_lists, deck_load_deck_into_editor).

Gets a card list of the slot's character (world_get_character_pointer_pair_84(slot, variant at slot +4, &count)) and loads the slot's recipe; for each listed card counts its copies in the recipe's main (or extra, for fusion/synchro) list and sets bit 6 of entry byte 5 on up to that many unflagged entries of editor list 0 (or 1). Side effects: editor list entries. Callers: 1 (deck_flag_owner_recipe_cards).

Loads the slot's recipe (deck_load_slot_recipe) and, for each card of its extra and main lists, sets bit 6 (from the owner's recipe) of entry byte 5 on the first entry of editor list 1 or 0 with that id that does not have it yet. Side effects: editor list entries. Callers: 1 (deck_flag_owner_recipe_cards).

Removes the card-move window from the window list 0x08ebf13c, frees its buffer (move record +0x24c) and the move record *0x08ebe3b0 on the editor heap *0x08ebf188, and clears 0x08ebe3b0. Side effects: heap frees, window list, 0x08ebe3b0. Callers: 1 (deck_update_card_move).

Removes the moved card from its source editor list: deck_remove_list_entry(list 0x08ebed00 + 0x20 x ((byte +6 of the move record *0x08ebe3b0 & 0x1f) >> 2), u16 at move +2) and returns its result. Side effects: those of deck_remove_list_entry. Callers: 3 (deck_animate_card_move_flight, deck_start_card_transfer, deck_start_undo_move).

Drops the moved card into its target list: target index = u16 at move record + 8 + 2 x ((byte +7 & 0x1f) >> 2) (record *0x08ebe3b0); copies the 6-byte entry at record +0x28, sets its copies to 1 and byte 5 bit 0, and adds it with deck_add_list_entry(0x08ebed00 + 0x20 x target, entry, -1). Side effects: those of deck_add_list_entry. Callers: 1 (deck_finish_card_move).

For the trunk (list 3, 0x08ebed60) returns the view position (index into its view array +0x10) of the entry holding card_id (deck_find_list_card), or the view count when absent; for other lists returns the view count (u16 at 0x08ebed00 + 0x20 x list + 0x14). No side effects. Callers: 4 (deck_start_card_transfer, deck_update_card_move, deck_finish_card_move, deck_handle_card_move_input).

Per-frame editor input: when no sub-screen is active, scrolls the card text; with a message open returns ui_update_deck_message(); otherwise dispatches on the mode 0x08ebee00 (0/6/7 browse, 1 card move, 2 command menu, 3 sort, 4 filter, 5 text search), updates the cursor rectangle and opens the help page (0x08ebee07 = -1) on button 0x8. Returns 0 except through the message path. Side effects: those handlers. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_scene_main).

Handles the browse-mode buttons pressed in pad +4: confirm starts a card transfer (deck_start_card_transfer); cancel toggles the save card byte-1 flag of the card under the cursor (save_set_card_byte1_flag); 0x8000 opens the sort menu, 0x1000 the filter menu; 0x0001 undoes the last move when the undo stack is not empty; sounds 0x7a05/0x7a08. Side effects: those actions, save card flags, sounds. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_handle_browse_input).

Checks the edited deck: 1 when the main total (0x08ebed0c) is below 40, 2 above 60, 3 when the side total exceeds 15, 4 when the extra total exceeds 15; 0 in entry mode 2; else 5 (with *out_card) for more forbidden cards than allowed (1 when save_test_progress_flag_e9_bit0, else 0) or a limited card with more copies across lists 0-2 than its limit; 0 when legal. Side effects: *out_card. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_handle_browse_input).

Rebuilds the view array (+0x10) of an editor list with every entry index; for the trunk (kind 3) the save setting save_get_setting_b0_bits6_7 filters it (1: only cards whose save_test_card_byte1_flag is 0, 2: only those with 1); stores the view count at +0x14, clears bits 6-9 of +0x16, sorts with deck_sort_list_view(list, 1, 0) and returns the view count. Side effects: list view. Callers: 9 (ui_run_text_search, deck_reload_editor_lists, ui_handle_pane_scroll_input, deck_init_editor_lists, ...).

Starts a text search over an editor list: clears the 0x14-byte search state at 0x08ebece0, stores the list's view count (+0x14) at 0x08ebece2 and text at 0x08ebecec, allocates a result array (count x 2 bytes) at 0x08ebece8 and a 0x10000-byte Horspool shift table filled with 0xff at 0x08ebecf0 (heap *0x08ebf188). Side effects: search state, heap. Callers: 1 (ui_run_text_search).

Advances the running text search by up to 48 view entries of list: appends the entry indices whose card matches (deck_card_matches_search_text with the text *0x08ebecec) to the result array 0x08ebece8 (count 0x08ebece4); returns progress in permille (position x 1000 / total), 1000 when finished or without a result array. Side effects: search state. Callers: 1 (ui_run_text_search).

Ends a text search: frees the shift table, copies the result indices into the list's view (+0x10, count +0x14) and frees them, sets the view mode bits 6-9 of +0x16 to 8, and moves the search text to the front of the 8-entry history of 0x40-byte UTF-16 strings at 0x08ebeee0 (the save's edit block), removing a duplicate. Side effects: list view, history, heap frees. Callers: 1 (ui_run_text_search).

Filters the list's view in place: keeps the view entries for which the predicate at 0x08ebd330 + 4 x filter returns non-zero (called with the card id and args[0]); filter 7 uses deck_filter_by_genre(entry, args); stores the new view count at +0x14 and filter in bits 6-9 of +0x16; returns the new count (the old one if the temporary allocation fails). Side effects: list view, temporary heap use. Callers: 1 (ui_handle_filter_value_window).
Filter predicate: true when bit deck_get_frame_category(card_db_get_frame(card_id)) of mask is set. No side effects. No direct caller (filter table 0x08ebd330).
Filter predicate: 1 when the card is a monster (card_db_is_monster) and bit card_db_get_race(card_id) of mask is set, else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (filter table 0x08ebd330).
Filter predicate: 1 when the card is a monster and bit card_db_get_attribute(card_id) of mask is set, else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (filter table 0x08ebd330).

Filter predicate: builds a level mask by OR-ing the u16 masks at 0x08ebd354, 0x08ebd356, 0x08ebd358 for mask bits 0, 1, 2 and returns 1 when the card is a monster and bit card_db_get_level(card_id) of that mask is set, else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (filter table 0x08ebd330).

Filter predicate on frame and icon: frame 8 with icon 4 (Continuous) -> mask 0x100, icon 1 (Counter) -> 0x80, icon 0 -> 0x200; frame 7 with icon 0 -> 0x40, 2 (Field) -> 2, 3 (Equip) -> 4, 4 (Continuous) -> 8, 5 (Quick-Play) -> 0x10, 6 (Ritual) -> 0x20; returns 1 when that mask bit is set, else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (filter table 0x08ebd330).
Filter predicate: true when bit deck_get_card_limit(deck_is_editing_other_deck(), card_id) of mask is set. No side effects. No direct caller (filter table 0x08ebd330).

Filter 7 of the deck editor: true when masks[0] bit 0 is set and the card is new (save_get_card_state 1); or masks[1] bit 6 is set and the card is marked (card_db_is_card_marked) with artworks (ui_count_card_artworks with resource 0x8032); or its genre words (card_db_get_genres) intersect masks[0] low 16 bits, masks[0] high 16 bits or masks[1] low 16 bits. No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_filter_list_view).

Normalises text (deck_normalize_search_text) and searches it with deck_search_text_horspool in, successively, the card name without ruby, the name's ruby reading, the description without ruby and the description's ruby reading (system_font_strip_ruby / system_font_extract_ruby_reading); true on the first match. No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_step_text_search).

Boyer-Moore-Horspool search of a UTF-16 pattern of length units in text, using the 64K-entry byte shift table *0x08ebecf0 (entries 0xff mean the full length); resets the used entries with deck_clear_search_shift_table and returns a pointer to the match in text, or 0. Side effects: shift table (restored). Callers: 1 (deck_card_matches_search_text).
Resets the Horspool shift-table entries used by a search pattern: table[pattern[i]] = 0xff for i < length - 1. Side effects: writes table. Callers: 1 (deck_search_text_horspool).

Copies the UTF-16 string in to out normalised for searching: full-width forms 0xff01-0xff5d become ASCII (+0x120 modulo 0x10000), katakana 0x30a1-0x30f4 become hiragana (-0x60), other characters go through system_towupper; NUL-terminates out. Side effects: writes out. Callers: 1 (deck_card_matches_search_text).
Registers the deck editor scene with system_scene_register(deck_editor_scene_main, deck_editor_scene_exit, 0x09e00870); returns 0. Side effects: scene registration. No direct caller.

Clears the editor globals (0x4a0 bytes at 0x08ebed00, 0x6c4 at 0x08ebf1a0), takes entry mode and owner kind from the scene transition word (kept in 0x08ebee04) and sets the slot (kind 2: transition >> 8, 1: save_get_partner(0), 0: slot 1), patches the layout, creates the 0xf41000-byte heap at 0x08ebf870 (0x08ebf188), sets thread attribute 0x4000, loads track 0x2c8 when needed, waits for the editor resources and runs deck_editor_init_state. Side effects: editor globals, heap, audio. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_scene_main).

Deck editor scene body: deck_editor_scene_enter, sets the frame callback ui_draw_deck_editor_frame, fades in and plays track 2, then loops wait_frame / deck_editor_update_subscreens / deck_editor_update(pad state) until it returns non-zero; fades out (stopping BGM unless entry mode 2), clears the frame callback, commits the edit with deck_commit_editor_to_slot and returns to the previous scene with system_scene_return(4, *0x08ebee04). Side effects: the whole editor session. No direct caller (registered by deck_editor_register_scene).

Deck editor scene shutdown: frees the editor lists, the window list 0x08ebf13c and the card view; stops the card-art reader *0x08ebf18c (card_db_cip_request_stop, then waits frames until card_db_cip_is_idle) and clears it; stops and unloads the module *0x08ebf194 when > 0; frees the editor heap block *0x08ebf188 with system_free_aligned. Side effects: frees all editor resources. No direct caller (registered by deck_editor_register_scene).

Initialises the editor: deck_init_editor_lists, reads the save's 0x200-byte edit block into 0x08ebeee0 (save_read_edit_block), sets the cursor pane, list pointers 0x08ebf1e0/0x08ebf20c, the layout from save_get_setting_b1_bits0_2, font options by language, the window list, the card detail panel, and the deck name 0x08ebedc0 (slot 1's name, or dictionary word 0x9c of resource 0x8033). Side effects: editor globals, font state. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_scene_enter).

Pushes a 10-byte move record on the editor's undo stack (8 records at 0x08ebf0e2, count 0x08ebf0e0): increments the count while below 8, otherwise shifts records 1-7 down one place (dropping the oldest) and writes into the last; copies record into the slot. Side effects: undo stack. Callers: 2 (deck_handle_card_move_input, deck_start_card_transfer).

Pops the deck editor's undo stack: when the count 0x08ebf0e0 is non-zero, decrements it and copies the 10-byte record at 0x08ebf0e2 + 10 x count to out; returns whether a record was popped. Side effects: 0x08ebf0e0, out. Callers: 1 (deck_start_undo_move).

Returns 1 when the list kind *list is 0 (main), 2 (side) or 4 (copy of the side list), else 0. No side effects. Callers: 5 (ui_draw_card_command_items, ui_draw_list_rows_compact, ui_draw_card_grid, ui_open_card_command_menu, ...).

Sets bit 5 (key card) of entry byte 5 to on & 1 for every entry with card_id in the three editor lists named by the table at 0x08ebd588. Side effects: editor list entries. Callers: 1 (ui_handle_card_command_choice).
Returns 1 when any entry of the three editor lists named by the table at 0x08ebd594 has the key-card flag (bit 5 of entry byte 5), else 0. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_open_deck_message).

Counts the distinct card ids that carry the key-card flag (bit 5 of entry byte 5) in the three editor lists named by the table at 0x08ebd5a0 (at most 40 tracked). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_open_card_command_menu).

Returns bits 0-1 of the deck editor state word 0x08ebee0c (entry mode taken from the scene transition word). No side effects. Callers: 3 (ui_check_editor_tutorial_hints, deck_check_deck_legality, deck_editor_scene_main).

Returns bits 2-3 of the deck editor state word 0x08ebee0c: 0 the player's deck, 1 the partner's, 2 another slot given by the transition word. No side effects. Callers: 2 (deck_editor_scene_enter, deck_is_editing_other_deck).

Returns bits 4-11 of the deck editor state word 0x08ebee0c, the deck slot being edited. No side effects. Callers: 10 (ui_open_deck_message, deck_build_main_deck_list, deck_commit_editor_to_slot, deck_editor_init_state, ...).

True when deck_get_editor_owner_kind() is not 0 (the editor works on a deck other than the player's). No side effects. Callers: 25 (ui_open_deck_message, deck_build_main_deck_list, deck_commit_editor_to_slot, deck_filter_by_limit, ...).

Per-frame dispatch of the editor's sub-screens from flag byte 0x08ebee06: bit 7 deck_run_deck_tutorial, bit 4 ui_run_card_detail_view, else 0x08ebee07 set runs ui_run_help_page, bits 5-6 == 1 deck_run_recipe_viewer; otherwise advances the counter 0x08ebf1b4 (after 16 frames sets bit 0 of byte +5 of *0x08ebf1b8) and reloads the cursor card text when the cursor card changed. Side effects: those sub-screens, 0x08ebf1b4. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_scene_main).

column2: void deck_sort_list_view(void *list, int mode, int order)
column3: Sorts the list's view: builds 8-byte records {view index, position, deck_get_card_sort_key(entry, list, mode)}, sorts them with system_qsort using comparator 0x08eab6bc (order 0) or 0x08eab744 (order 1), writes the indices back and stores mode in bits 0-3 and order in bits 4-5 of +0x16. Side effects: list view, temporary heap use. Callers: 8 (deck_commit_editor_to_slot, deck_reset_list_view, ui_handle_pane_scroll_input, ui_finish_card_command_menu, ...).

Sort key of an entry: mode 10 0xffff - copies, 9 limit, 2 frame, 1 card_db_get_sort_position; frame 8 with mode 8 the byte at 0x08ebdab8[icon], frame 7 with mode 8 the byte at 0x08ebdab0[icon]; non-spell/trap cards: 7 attribute, 6 race, 5 0xffff - DEF and 4 0xffff - ATK (0x10000 for '?'), 3 0xffff - level; -2 otherwise. No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_sort_list_view).

Group value of an entry for sort mode mode: 10 copies (trunk entry or deck_get_list_card_count), 9 limit, 2 frame, 1 card_db_get_top_group; frames 7 and 8 give the icon (0 -> 7) for mode 8, else -2; other cards: 7 attribute, 6 race, 5 DEF, 4 ATK (-1 for '?'), 3 level; -2 otherwise. No side effects. Callers: 2 (ui_draw_sort_group_header, ui_find_sort_group_index).

column2: void ui_draw_text_with_width(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text); the text argument is passed through in its register (hidden by the decompiler; ui.md, font_px_wrappers). Side effects: those of system_font_draw_text (text drawn). Callers: 1 (ui_draw_search_input_box).

Maps a card frame (card_db_get_frame) to the editor's category: 0, 1, 2, 3 unchanged, 10 -> 4, 7 -> 5, 8 -> 6, any other -> -1. No side effects. Callers: 4 (ui_draw_card_frame_plate, deck_count_cards_by_frame, deck_filter_by_frame, ui_draw_sort_group_header).

Returns 1 when card_id appears in the key-card list of deck slot slot (deck_get_slot_key_card_count, deck_get_slot_key_card), else 0. No side effects. Callers: 2 (deck_build_main_deck_list, deck_build_side_deck_list).

Returns 1 when card_id is one of the ids of the key-card list list (deck_get_key_card_list_count, deck_get_key_card_list_entry), 0 when not or when list is NULL. No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_load_deck_into_editor).

Reads the recipe of deck slot slot (game state +0x48d0 + 0x16c x slot) and, when it is >= 0, loads it into deck with deck_load_recipe; returns recipe >= 0. Side effects: writes deck. Callers: 3 (deck_flag_all_recipe_cards, deck_init_editor_lists, deck_flag_listed_recipe_cards).

column2: int deck_get_other_deck_card_allowance(int slot, int card_id, void *recipe_deck)
column3: Copies of card_id another owner's deck may use: 0 for id 0 or tokens; 3 when the player has obtained it (save_get_card_state != 0), when recipe_deck (0xc0-byte deck) holds it, or when slot's lists hold it (main/side, or extra for fusion/synchro); else 0. No side effects. Callers: 2 (deck_get_other_deck_free_copies, deck_build_trunk_list).

column2: int deck_get_other_deck_free_copies(int slot, int card_id, void *recipe_deck)
column3: Returns deck_get_other_deck_card_allowance(slot, card_id, recipe_deck) minus the copies of card_id in slot's main and side lists (extra and side for fusion/synchro cards). No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_build_trunk_list).

column2: void ui_draw_card_name_text(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text); the text argument is passed through in its register (hidden by the decompiler; ui.md, font_px_wrappers). Side effects: those of system_font_draw_text (text drawn). Callers: 2 (ui_draw_card_row_compact, ui_draw_card_row_detailed).
Empty function: returns immediately. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_help_update).
Returns index + [0x09e00b84] (the help chapter base). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_help_update).
Returns chapter - [0x09e00b84] (the help chapter base). No side effects. Callers: 4 (ui_help_open, ui_help_update, ui_help_load_chapter, ui_help_update_page_index).
Clears the word at list +0x08 (the list result). Side effects: writes list +0x08. Callers: 1 (ui_list_widget_reset).
Empty function: returns immediately. No side effects. No direct caller (reached through a pointer).
Sets bit 0 of the flag byte at list +0x04 to bit 0 of enabled (other bits kept). Side effects: writes list +0x04. No direct caller (reached through a pointer).
Returns the u16 cursor at list +0x02. No side effects. No direct caller (reached through a pointer).
Sets the help topic-list flag 0x09e00d28 to 1. Side effects: writes 0x09e00d28. Callers: 1 (ui_help_update).
Returns the cursor of the help topic list 0x09e00d40 (ui_list_widget_get_cursor: u16 at +0x02). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_help_update).

Returns the entry count. Side effects: the list's entry and view arrays. Callers: 2 (deck_reload_editor_lists, deck_init_editor_lists).

Side-deck list builder: for each card of list 2 of the edited slot writes an entry {id, image index (resource 0x8031), 1 copy, flags cleared} and its view index; for the player's own deck each save card-list entry with state 2 sets byte 4 bit 7 on the last matching entry that lacks it; entries whose id is in the slot's key-card list get the key flag (byte 5 bit 5). Returns the entry count. Side effects: the list's entry and view arrays. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer; presumably the builder table 0x08ebd21c like the other list builders, hypothesis medium).

Empties the main, extra and side lists (0-2): card-list items (entry byte 4 bit 7) are appended to the pool (list 5) with their view index; other entries are merged into the trunk (list 3: copies added and byte 5 bit 0 OR-ed into an existing entry of the id, else appended with 1 copy). Clears the counts, totals, views and scroll/view-mode fields of lists 0-2 and of list 4, recounts frames, updates the totals of lists 3 and 5, resets the pane 0 cursor fields (0x08ebf1e6-0x08ebf1eb) and re-places the pane 1 cursor (ui_place_pane_cursor). No return value. Side effects: editor lists 0x08ebed00-0x08ebedbf, pane cursors. Callers: 2 (ui_handle_deck_options_submenu, deck_load_deck_into_editor).

column2: void deck_load_deck_into_editor(void *deck, void *key_cards, ushort *name, int slot)
column3: Loads a 0xc0-byte deck (u32 counts +0 main, +4 side, +8 extra; u16 ids at +0xc, +0x84, +0xa2) into the editor: for slot 1 copies name into 0x08ebedc0 (cleared when NULL); returns the current deck to the trunk (deck_return_deck_cards_to_trunk); for each main, side and extra id builds an entry (image index from ui_find_card_image_index with resource 0x8031, 1 copy; key flag bit 5 of byte 5 when deck_card_list_contains(key_cards, id), main and side only) and moves one copy from the trunk (list 3) into list 0, 2 or 1, or else from the pool (list 5) with byte 4 bit 7 set; ids found in neither are skipped. Then resets and sorts (mode 1) the views of lists 0, 2, 4 and 1, clears the undo count 0x08ebf0e0, recounts frames and flags the owner's recipe cards (deck_flag_owner_recipe_cards(slot)). No return value. Side effects: editor lists, deck name, undo stack. No direct caller (passed as a callback to the recipe viewer module by deck_run_recipe_viewer).

Writes the edited deck back to the save when the editor closes: stores the pool entries (list 5, array *0x08ebeda4, count from its total 0x08ebedac) as save card-list entries with state 4; clears the slot's cards and key cards; writes list 0 (main, entry order) to slot list 1, list 2 (side) to slot list 2 and list 1 (extra, in view order after resetting a filtered view and sorting by mode 1) to slot list 3 with deck_set_slot_card/deck_set_slot_count; entries with byte 4 bit 7 become card-list entries with state 1, 2 or 3, other entries lose their new state (save_clear_card_new when save_get_card_state is 1), and key-flagged entries (byte 5 bit 5) are added with deck_add_slot_key_card. For the player's own deck it sets the card-list count and member 0's deck name from 0x08ebedc0; trunk cards also lose their new state. Finally saves the 0x200-byte edit block 0x08ebeee0 (save_write_edit_block) and the layout index (ui_select_layout_index -> save_set_setting_b1_bits0_2). No return value. Side effects: deck slot, save card list, card states, edit block, settings. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_scene_main).

Opens the card-move menu for the card under the active pane's cursor (pane = bits 4-5 of 0x08ebf1a0): allocates the 0x250-byte move record *0x08ebe3b0 on the editor heap *0x08ebf188 (byte +6 bits 0-1 source pane, bits 2-4 source list, bits 5-6 target pane; u16 +6 bits 7-9 target count, u16 targets at +8, full flags at +0xe, 6-byte entry copy at +0x28) and builds the target candidates by source list: main/extra/side -> pool 5 for card-list items (entry byte 4 bit 7) or trunk 3, plus side (list 2, or 4 in dual-pane layout) from main/extra and main/extra from side in single-pane layout; trunk/pool -> extra 1 (frames 3/10) or main 0, plus side when editing the player's deck; list 4 -> main/extra. A target is flagged full at 20 cards (extra, side) or above 64 (main). Returns 9 when an allocation fails, 0 without a cursor entry or on success, (card id << 16) | 8 for a card of the owner's recipe (entry byte 5 bit 6) while editing another deck, 4 when 3 same-name copies are already in lists 0-2, 7/6/5 when the semi-limited/limited/forbidden allowance is used up (forbidden: deck_count_forbidden_cards against 1 when save_test_progress_flag_e9_bit0, else 0), 2 when no target exists. On success preselects the last-used target (0x08ebe3b4/0x08ebe3b6), sets bit 0 of 0x08ebf1ac, places the label (ui_set_card_move_label, ui_place_card_move_label), allocates and opens the 0x78-byte window descriptor (record +0x24c) in window list 0x08ebf13c, sets editor mode 0x08ebee00 = 1 and move state 1. Side effects: heap, move record, window list, editor mode. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_handle_browse_input).

Undo of the last card move: pops a 10-byte record (deck_pop_undo_move) and replays it backwards: allocates the move record *0x08ebe3b0 with the record's target list as source and its source as the only target, adapted to the pane layout (single pane: pane 0, list 4 shown as 2; dual pane: side shown as 4 when going to main/extra, pane = source list > 2, target pane = the other), copies the entry to +0x28, sets editor mode 0x08ebee00 = 1 and move state 7; finds the entry in the source list (the recorded index if its id and byte 4 bit 7 still match, else the last matching entry) and its view position (+4), takes the start position from ui_get_list_slot_position and removes the card from the source (deck_remove_card_move_source). Returns 1 when an undo started, 0 when the stack is empty or the allocation fails. Side effects: undo stack, heap, move record, editor lists. Callers: 2 (ui_finish_card_command_menu, deck_editor_handle_tool_input).

Quick transfer of the cursor card to its default list without the menu: allocates the 0x250-byte move record *0x08ebe3b0 and picks one target: from main/extra/side the pool (list 5) for card-list items (entry byte 4 bit 7), else the trunk (list 3), aborting for a card of the owner's recipe while editing another deck; from trunk/pool the extra deck (frames 3/10, aborting at 20 cards) or the main deck (aborting above 64), aborting when 3 same-name copies are already in lists 0-2 or the card's limit (below 3) is reached; from list 4 the main deck. Pushes the 10-byte undo record {source | target << 4, entry, target view position} (deck_push_undo_move), sets editor mode 0x08ebee00 = 1 and move state 7 (flight to the target), takes the start position from ui_get_list_slot_position (+0x230, +0x248/+0x24a) and removes the card from its source list (deck_remove_card_move_source). Returns 1 when the transfer started, 0 otherwise (record freed). Side effects: heap, move record, undo stack, editor lists. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_handle_tool_input).

Per-frame card-move state machine on the low nibble of byte 0 of the move record *0x08ebe3b0: 1 deck_animate_card_move_flight; 2 waits for the move window's opening transition (ui_window_is_transition_done on list 0x08ebf13c) and goes to 3; 3 deck_handle_card_move_input; 4 (cancel) after the window transition re-adds the entry to its source list at its old view position (deck_add_list_entry), cycles the pane back in single-pane layout and goes to 8; 6 after (+0x22e bits 1-3) frames, once ui_get_list_slot_position reports the target slot, closes the window and goes to 5 (7 without a window); 5 waits for the window transition (then 7) and falls through into 7; 7 deck_finish_card_move; 8 stores the target pane and list in 0x08ebe3b4/0x08ebe3b6, frees the move (deck_free_card_move), clears editor mode 0x08ebee00 and bit 0 of 0x08ebf1ac and returns 1. Returns 0 while the move runs and for other states. Side effects: those of the steps, window list. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_update).

When the index is outside the visible window and scroll is non-zero (and the list kind word is not 3) it scrolls the pane by one row (1 entry in list layout, a row of columns in grid layout), stores the step in bits 1-3 of move-record byte +0x22e and returns 0 so the caller retries; otherwise writes x + 11 and y + 15 (pane-1 list layout in layout modes below 4 adds 1 to y) to out_xy[0..1] and returns 1. Returns nothing. Side effects: pane +6. Callers: 1 (ui_handle_pane_scroll_input).

Moves the active pane's cursor to the next (back = 0) or previous (back = 1) sort group: back is passed unchanged in a0 to ui_find_sort_group_index (Ghidra shows no parameter); with a non-negative index it sets the first visible index (+6), column (+8) and row (+0xa) so that the entry is visible, clamping the scroll to the last full page in grid layout and to count - visible rows in list layout. Does nothing for an empty list. Returns nothing. Side effects: pane +6/+8/+0xa of the active pane. Callers: 1 (ui_handle_pane_scroll_input).

Finds the view index of the neighbouring group in the active pane's list (pane record 0x08ebf1e0, list view array list +0x10, entries list +4, 6 bytes each) under the list's sort mode (low nibble of list +0x16): the group key is deck_get_card_group_key(entry, list, mode), divided by 100 for modes 4 and 5. Forward (back = 0) returns the first index after the cursor (ui_get_pane_cursor_index) whose key differs, or -1 at the end; backward returns the first index of the group before the cursor (scanning back while the key equals the previous entry's key), 0 at the start or -1 at index 0; for modes 4-5 backward steps only one entry. With no entry under the cursor returns count - 1. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_jump_pane_to_group).

Scrolls the card text of the detail panel. In layout modes below 4 (low nibble of 0x08ebf1a0) it delegates to ui_scroll_text_by_analog(0x08ebf1bc). Otherwise, when the text width 0x08ebf1a4 is positive, it moves the marquee offset 0x08ebf1a8 with the analog value at pad +0x10 (above 0xc0: forward by (v - 0xc0) x 6, clamped to the width when already inside it; below 0x40: backward, clamped to 0), else auto-advances by 0x40 per frame once the delay counter 0x08ebf1b4 exceeds 0x35, and wraps the offset at width + 0x76c0 (units of 1/64 px). Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x08ebf1a8. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_update).

Computes the cursor rectangle of the active pane into the u16 globals 0x08ebf132 (x), 0x08ebf134 (y), 0x08ebf136 (width), 0x08ebf138 (height): in grid layout x = pane x + grid offset + column x column pitch, y likewise with the row pitch, size 0x17 x 0x1f; in list layout x = pane x + cell offset + 1, y = pane y + cell offset + 1 + row x row height, width = row width (+0x1a) - 3, height = row height (+0x1c) - 1, except pane 1 in layout modes below 4, which uses its +0x14/+0x16 offsets without the +1 and width - 1. Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x08ebf132-0x08ebf139. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_update).

Opens the editor's message window: clears the 0x120-byte list-window record 0x08ebe3b8 and the 0x800-byte UTF-16 text buffer 0x08ebe4d8, stores arg's low half in 0x08ebecd8 and builds the text from strTbl.bin (ui_deck_get_resource(0x8033)) by kind: 2 deck-rule error (string from the u16 table 0x08ebd248 indexed by arg; arg 8 formats the string at 0x08ebd258 with the card name of id arg >> 16 and the editor slot owner's name, world_get_character_name_string_first), 3 key-card question (string 0x21 when deck_has_key_card is 1, else 0x22; 2 choices), 4 a string from the u16 table 0x08ebd25c, 5 card-limit notice for card arg (strings 0xb8-0xbb by deck_get_card_limit status 0/1/2 and progress flag e9 bit 0), 6 filter result (0x53 when arg is 0, else 0x52 with the count), 7 tutorial hint (0xb1 with arg + 1 and string arg + 0xc3; 3 choices); 0 and 1 leave the text empty. Then fills the window layout (font 0xc, colour 0xff000000, heap *0x08ebf188, choice count in the low nibble of +0xca), opens it with ui_open_list_window, centres it on the 480 x 272 screen and stores kind in bits 7-14 of 0x08ebf1a0. Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x08ebe3b8-0x08ebecd7, 0x08ebecd8, 0x08ebf1a0. Callers: 4 (ui_check_editor_tutorial_hints, ui_handle_filter_value_window, ui_run_text_search, deck_editor_handle_browse_input).

Updates the message window 0x08ebe3b8 (ui_update_list_window). A Start press (pad +4 bit 3) while a kind-4 message is open stores the byte from the u16 table 0x08ebd268 indexed by the message argument 0x08ebecd8 into 0x08ebee07, and for kind 5 stores 2 there (help-page request, hypothesis, confidence low). When the window returns a result (not -1) it resets the window and clears the kind bits of 0x08ebf1a0; for kind 7 a result of 2 sets bit 7 of 0x08ebee06 (hints off, hypothesis, medium) and any other result runs ui_check_editor_tutorial_hints. Returns 1 when a kind-3 message (key-card question) was answered with choice 1, else 0. Side effects: 0x08ebee06, 0x08ebee07, 0x08ebf1a0, window record. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_update).
Draws the editor message window 0x08ebe3b8 with ui_draw_list_window and returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_editor_overlays).

Opens the filter menu: allocates the 0x18-byte filter record *0x08ebecdc from heap *0x08ebf188 (+0 state, +2 sub-state, +3 bit 0 any marked card and bits 1-4 value column, +4 value row, +8 two-word value bitmask, +0x10 menu window, +0x14 value window) and a 0x120-byte list window at +0x10 (title strTbl.bin string 0xa7, 7 items 0xa4 x 0x12 px, item callback 0x08ea3248), centred horizontally at y 0x3a. Scans card ids 0xe88-0x1f39 and sets +3 bit 0 when a valid card is marked (card_db_is_card_marked). Pre-selects the item of the active list's current filter (list +0x16 bits 6-9, minus 1, 0 when out of 0..6) in window +0xd2 and sets the editor mode 0x08ebee00 = 4. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap allocations, *0x08ebecdc, 0x08ebee00. Callers: 2 (ui_handle_list_tools_submenu, deck_editor_handle_tool_input).

Per-frame step of the filter menu (editor mode 4) by the filter record state (*0x08ebecdc +0): 0 updates the menu window; cancel (-2) starts closing it and goes to state 2, a chosen item i opens the value window for filter i + 1 (ui_open_filter_value_window), plays 0x7a08, clears the cursor, column, bitmask and sub-state and goes to state 1; 1 runs ui_handle_filter_value_window; 2 waits for the menu window to close, then frees it (ui_close_filter_menu) and returns to editor mode 0 (0x08ebee00). Returns nothing. Side effects: filter record, 0x08ebee00, sound. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_update).

Value-window step of the filter menu by sub-state (filter record +2): 0 input: the cursor is a grid (column in record +3 bits 1-4, row in +4 low nibble, row 0xf = the OK button) over the values first..last of the filter's 8-byte record in the table 0x08ebd2ac (u16 first, u16 last, draw callback; the last value is excluded for filter 7 when no card is marked); Up/Down/Left/Right move with wrap and sound 0x7a04; confirm (system_get_confirm_button(0)) on OK chooses item 0 and goes to 1, on a value toggles its bit in the bitmask at record +8 (sound 0x7a05); cancel closes the value window (sub-state 3, sound 0x7a06). 1 waits for the window then closes both (2). 2 when closed: an empty list only stores the filter number in list +0x16 bits 6-9, otherwise deck_filter_list_view(list, filter, bitmask) and the cursor is reset with ui_place_pane_cursor; then frees the menu, opens deck message 6 with the resulting count, plays 0x7a0c and returns to editor mode 0. 3 when the value window has closed it is reset and the menu becomes active again (state 0). Returns nothing. Side effects: filter record, active list view, pane cursor, 0x08ebee00, sounds. Callers: 1 (ui_update_filter_menu).

Resets and frees the value window (+0x14, if any) and the menu window (+0x10) of the filter record, then the record itself, all from heap *0x08ebf188, and clears *0x08ebecdc. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap frees, 0x08ebecdc. Callers: 2 (ui_update_filter_menu, ui_handle_filter_value_window).

Draws the filter menu: in layout modes above 1 first shades the inactive pane with ui_draw_pane_shade(list, other pane, its list kind, 1), then draws the menu window (record +0x10) and, when open, the value window (+0x14) with ui_draw_list_window. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_editor_overlays).

Allocates (or reuses) the 0x120-byte value window at filter record +0x14 and opens it for filter 1..7: x = the menu's centred x + 0x6d, y = menu y + 4 + filter x 0x12, width 0x8a, height 0x19 x ceil(count / 5) + 0x35 with count = last - first + 1 from the table 0x08ebd2ac, cells 0x19 x 0x19, 5 columns (fewer when count < 5), item callback ui_draw_filter_value_items at +0x100; filter 7 uses 0xb7 x 0xe4, 6 columns and y = menu y - 0x16, filter 5 width 0xa3 and 6 columns, filter 3 0xa3 x 0x4e and 6 columns, filter 1 4 columns. Returns nothing (also on allocation failure). Side effects: heap allocation, filter record +0x14, window opened with ui_open_list_window. Callers: 1 (ui_update_filter_menu).

column2: void ui_draw_filter_value_items(void *list, int x, int y, int width, int height)
column3: Item-draw callback of the filter value window (installed at window +0x100 by ui_open_filter_value_window): draws the caption bar from resource 0x8006, the label of the value under the cursor (ui_get_filter_value_label, scale 0xc, white, fitted to width - 0x15), then for every value of the filter's range a check mark (ui_draw_filter_check_mark) when its bit is set in the record's bitmask, the cursor frame (0x18 x 0x18) on the selected cell and the value icon through the filter's draw callback in the table 0x08ebd2b0 (8-byte stride) at the cell centre, and finally the OK button (ui_draw_list_window_button, highlighted when row 0xf is selected) with strTbl.bin string 0x20 centred in it. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE and font commands. No direct caller (window callback +0x100).

column2: void ui_draw_filter_value_text(int x, int y, ushort *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) x 64, text). Returns nothing. Side effects: font commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_filter_value_items).

column2: void ui_filter_draw_text_fit_width_px(int x, int y, int width, ushort *text)
column3: Pixel text wrapper that Ghidra shows as empty: per the font_px_wrappers family established from the instructions (ui.md), it shifts x, y and width left by 6 and tail-calls font_draw_text_fit_width; used to draw the filter value label. Returns nothing. Side effects: font commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_filter_value_items).

column2: void * ui_draw_icon_grid_7col(void *list, short x, short y, uint index)
column3: Draws a 17 x 17 icon from the texture of resource 0x800b: cell index % 7 across (u = (index % 7) x 17) and index / 7 down from v = 0x33, white ambient colour, nearest filtering. Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged when the resource is missing). Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer, probably a draw callback of the filter table 0x08ebd2ac, hypothesis, medium).

column2: void * ui_draw_icon_16px(void *list, short x, short y, uint index)
column3: Draws a 16 x 16 icon: indices 0xb and 0xc come from resource 0x800a with (u, v) pairs from the u16 table 0x08ebd2f4; other indices from resource 0x800c laid out 8 per row (index < 0xb: cell index; index > 0xc: cell index - 2). White ambient colour, nearest filtering. Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged when the resource is missing). Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer, probably a draw callback of the filter table 0x08ebd2ac, hypothesis, medium).

column2: void * ui_draw_table_icon_a(void *list, int kind, int x, int y)
column3: For kind != 0 draws a 17 x 17 icon described by the 6-byte record 0x08ebd274 + 6 x kind (u16 resource id for ui_deck_get_resource, u8 u, u8 v). Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged for kind 0 or a missing resource). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_pane_status).

column2: void * ui_draw_filter_check_mark(void *list, short x, short y)
column3: Draws the 26 x 26 check-mark sprite at texture (0x9a, 0xc0) of resource 0x8006 at (x, y). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_filter_value_items).

Returns the UTF-16 label of value `value` of filter `filter`: 1 strTbl.bin string from the u16 table 0x08ebd2fc, 2 card_db_get_race_name, 3 card_db_get_attribute_name, 4 strTbl.bin string from the u16 table 0x08ebd30c, 5 from the u16 table 0x08ebd314 offset by 4 entries, 6 from 0x08ebd314, 7 card_db_get_genre_name; NULL for other filters. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_filter_value_items).

Switches the deck editor to layout 0-7: saves the pane cursors into their lists (ui_store_pane_cursors, pane 0 only in single-pane modes, both otherwise), takes pane 0's list-layout flag and geometry from the 8-byte layout record 0x08ebd3f4 + 8 x layout (s16 pane-0 flag, s16 pane-0 geometry, s16 pane-1 flag, s16 pane-1 geometry, -1 = unchanged) by copying the 0x1e-byte geometry record 0x08ebd35c + 0x1e x index to pane +0xc, stores layout in the low nibble of 0x08ebf1a0 and restores each pane's scroll and cursor from its list (+0x18, +0x1c, +0x1a, +0x1d) with ui_place_pane_cursor. Going to a single-pane layout while pane 1 was active makes pane 0 active and shows pane 1's list there (list 5 stays 5, 4 becomes 2, 3 stays 3); going to two panes while pane 0 shows list 3-5 puts list 0 in pane 0 and that list in pane 1 (active). Finally replays the list-tab frames (ui_play_list_tab_frames) and reloads the cursor card text when there is an entry. Returns nothing. Side effects: pane records 0x08ebf1e0/0x08ebf20c, 0x08ebf1a0, list cursor fields. Callers: 3 (deck_editor_init_state, ui_apply_layout_choice, deck_editor_handle_browse_input).

column2: int ui_select_layout_index(short pane_count, int narrow, short pane0_list_layout, short pane1_list_layout)
column3: Maps a layout description to the layout index 0-7: one pane gives 0 with list layout (flag 1) and 1 with grid layout (flag 0); two narrow panes (narrow != 0, layout modes 2-3) give 2 (grid, grid) or 3 (grid, list); two wide panes (modes 4-7) give 5 (grid, grid), 7 (grid, list), 6 (list, grid) or 4 (list, list). Returns -1 for any other combination. No side effects. Callers: 3 (deck_commit_editor_to_slot, ui_open_layout_submenu, deck_editor_handle_browse_input).

Returns the list-box extent of editor list `list` (0-5) for the current layout class: 10-byte records at 0x08ebd440 (layout modes 0-1), 0x08ebd47c (2-3) or 0x08ebd4b8 (4-7); the result is the 9-bit x of u16 [0] in the low half and the 9-bit width of u16 [1] in the high half. No side effects. Callers: 5 (ui_get_list_slot_position, ui_place_card_move_label, ui_calc_list_tab_rect_narrow, ui_draw_pane_shade, ...).

column2: uint ui_calc_list_tab_rect(ushort list, ushort shown_list, ushort *out_rect)
column3: Fills out_rect (x, y, width, height as u16) with the tab rectangle of list `list` from the layout-class record (see ui_get_list_box_extent; tab x and width are u16 [2] and [3]): the shown list's tab is y 0x19, height 0xd; other tabs are y 0x1b, height 0xb, and in layout modes 2-3 (for lists 3 and 5 that are not shown) are clipped against the boxes of list 4 and of shown_list so that tabs do not overlap. Returns the anchor x tab x + width - (width - 8 x n) / 2 - 1, n = bits 1-5 of record byte 7 (hypothesis: the label's text position, medium). Side effects: writes out_rect. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_list_tabs).

column2: void ui_calc_list_tab_rect_narrow(ushort list, ushort shown_list, ushort *out_rect)
column3: Variant of ui_calc_list_tab_rect for 0x22-pixel tabs: x = tab x - 0x22 (in layout modes 2-3 the tab x of the record for lists 0-2 when they are not shown), width 0x22, y/height 0x19/0xd for the shown list and 0x1b/0xb otherwise, with the same clipping against list 4 and shown_list for the second pane's lists. Returns nothing. Side effects: writes out_rect. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_list_tabs).

Returns the frame of the list-tab layout that matches the panes' lists. Single-pane modes (0x08ebf1a0 low nibble < 2): pane0_list (5 counts as 4) plus 4 when the player has save card-list items (save_get_card_list_count > 0, own deck only). Two-pane modes: base 9 (modes 2-3) or 0x18 (4-7) + 5 x pane0_list, + 2 with card-list items, + pane1_list (minus 3 when above 2). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_play_list_tab_frames).

Shows the list tabs for the current panes: takes the tab layout resource 0x8022 (own deck) or 0x8023 (another owner's deck, deck_is_editing_other_deck), computes the frame with ui_get_list_tab_frame(pane-0 list kind, pane-1 list kind) and sets the .ehf play range to [frame, frame + 1] (ui_ehf_set_play_range). Returns nothing. Side effects: the layout's play range. Callers: 3 (ui_set_editor_layout, ui_cycle_pane_list, deck_run_deck_tutorial).

When editing another owner's deck (deck_is_editing_other_deck) copies the 9-bit box x and width of list 2 (side deck) in the single-pane extent table (0x08ebd454/0x08ebd458) into list 3 (trunk, 0x08ebd45e/0x08ebd462), so the trunk box takes the place of the side deck that such decks do not show. Returns nothing. Side effects: the extent table 0x08ebd440. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_scene_enter).

Per-frame draw of the deck editor scene, chosen by the sub-screen flags byte 0x08ebf1dc: bit 0 the card viewer (ui_card_viewer_draw), else bit 3 the help viewer (ui_help_draw on GE layer 4, then system_ge_commit_layer_pointer), else bit 1 the recipe viewer (deck_recipe_viewer_draw), else bit 2 the deck tutorial (deck_tutorial_draw), otherwise the editor itself (ui_draw_deck_editor_screen). Returns nothing. Side effects: GE drawing. No direct caller (the scene's draw callback, reached through a function pointer).

Opens the Triangle command menu: allocates the 0x18-byte menu record *0x09e0087c (byte 0 bit 0 no-card mode, +2 sub-state, +4 entry, +8/+0xa/+0xc layout-submenu values, +0xe trunk option, +0x10 main window, +0x14 submenu) and a 0x120-byte list window (title strTbl.bin string 0x50, items 0xe8 x 0x13, item drawer ui_draw_card_command_items at +0x100) from heap *0x08ebf188. With an entry the menu has 8 items (0 card details, 1 card byte-1 flag toggle, 2 key card, 3 list tools, 4 deck options, 5 layout, 6 clear filter, 7 undo); with entry NULL only items 3-7. The disabled mask (window +0xdc) greys undo when the undo count 0x08ebf0e0 is 0, clear filter when the active list has no filter, and the key-card item when the list is not main or side, when the entry is not a key card and deck_count_key_cards is 0x28 or more, or when the cursor card's frame (card_db_get_frame of 0x08ebf1b0) is 3 or 10. The window is opened, widened to at least 0xe8 and centred; editor mode 0x08ebee00 = 2. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap, *0x09e0087c, 0x08ebee00. Callers: 2 (deck_editor_handle_browse_input, ui_reopen_card_command_menu).

Rebuilds the command menu for a new entry (after the recipe viewer returns): remembers the absolute selected item (window +0xd0 + low 5 bits of +0xd2), closes the menu (ui_close_card_command_menu), opens it again with ui_open_card_command_menu(entry) and restores the selection, shifting it by 3 when the menu changed between the card and the no-card form. Returns nothing. Side effects: as ui_open_card_command_menu. Callers: 1 (deck_run_recipe_viewer).

Per-frame step of the command menu (editor mode 2) by the record's sub-state (+2): 0 ui_handle_card_command_choice, 1 ui_handle_list_tools_submenu, 2 ui_handle_deck_options_submenu, 3 ui_handle_layout_submenu (with pad), 4 ui_handle_trunk_option_submenu, 5 ui_handle_trunk_option_confirm, 10 ui_finish_card_command_menu. In sub-states 0-4 a Start press (pad +4 bit 3) instead stores a help topic in 0x08ebee07 (8, 0x11, 0x18, 0xe, 0x16). Returns 0 (or the finish step's result, also 0). Side effects: through the handlers, 0x08ebee07. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_update).

Draws the command menu window (record +0x10) and, when open, its submenu window (+0x14) with ui_draw_list_window. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_editor_overlays).

Resets and frees the submenu window (+0x14, if any) and the main window (+0x10) of the command menu record, frees the record from heap *0x08ebf188 and clears *0x09e0087c. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap frees, 0x09e0087c. Callers: 3 (ui_reopen_card_command_menu, ui_handle_list_tools_submenu, ui_finish_card_command_menu).

Sub-state 0 of the command menu: updates the main window and acts on the chosen item (offset by 3 in no-card mode). Cancel (-2), 6 (clear filter) and 7 (undo) start closing the window and go to sub-state 10. 0 sets bit 4 of 0x08ebee06 (open the card detail view); 1 toggles the entry card's save byte-1 flag (save_test_card_byte1_flag / save_set_card_byte1_flag); 2 toggles the key-card flag (deck_set_key_card_flag, from entry byte 5 bit 5); these keep the window open. 3, 4 and 5 open the list-tools, deck-options and layout submenus (sub-states 1, 2, 3) with sound 0x7a08. Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x08ebee06, save card flags, key-card flags, menu record and windows. Callers: 1 (ui_update_card_command_menu).

Sub-state 10: once the main window has finished closing (state byte +0xe9 != 5) frees the menu; a final choice of 7 starts an undo (deck_start_undo_move; returns at once when it started, leaving the editor mode to the move), 6 clears the active list's filter (deck_reset_list_view) and re-sorts it with its own mode and order (deck_sort_list_view); then the editor mode 0x08ebee00 returns to 0. Returns 0. Side effects: menu freed, list view, 0x08ebee00. Callers: 1 (ui_update_card_command_menu).

column2: int ui_open_command_submenu(ushort title, ushort caption, short item_count, void *item_callback)
column3: Prepares the command menu's submenu window (record +0x14; allocated as 0x120 bytes from heap *0x08ebf188 when absent): cleared, x = main window x + 0x28, y = 0x7c, caption strTbl.bin string `caption` at +0x84 (when non-zero, font 0xc, colour 0xff000000), title string `title` at +0xa0 (when non-zero), items 0xe8 x 0x13, item_count at +0xcc and the item-label callback at +0xfc. Does not open it. Returns 1, or 0 when the allocation failed. Side effects: heap, the submenu window. Callers: 4 (ui_open_deck_options_submenu, ui_open_list_tools_submenu, ui_open_layout_submenu, ui_open_trunk_option_submenu).

Opens the list-tools submenu: ui_open_command_submenu(title 0x4d, no caption, 4 items, label callback 0x08ea816c), sets window flag bit 3 of +200 and opens it with ui_open_list_window. Items: 0 sort, 1 filter, 2 text search, 3 trunk display option. Returns nothing. Side effects: submenu window. Callers: 2 (ui_handle_trunk_option_submenu, ui_handle_card_command_choice).

Sub-state 1 of the command menu: updates the list-tools submenu; when a result arrives during the window's state 3 it starts closing it (and the main window for results 0-2); once closed it frees the submenu and acts: cancel (-2) returns to sub-state 0 with the main window active, 3 opens the trunk option submenu (sub-state 4), 2 the text search (ui_open_text_search_menu), 1 the filter menu (ui_open_filter_menu), 0 the sort menu (ui_open_sort_menu); the last three also free the command menu. Choices play 0x7a08. Returns nothing. Side effects: menu record, windows, the opened tool's state. Callers: 1 (ui_update_card_command_menu).

Opens the deck-options submenu: ui_open_command_submenu(title 0x4c, no caption, 6 items, label callback 0x08ea8198); disables item 1 (mask bit 1 at window +0xdc) when the main list's total word (0x08ebed0c) exceeds 60 or the extra (0x08ebed2c) or side (0x08ebed4c) totals exceed 15, and disables items 1, 2, 4 and 5 (mask 0x36) when editing another owner's deck; then opens it. Returns nothing. Side effects: submenu window. Callers: 1 (ui_handle_card_command_choice).

Sub-state 2: when the deck-options submenu returns, frees it and acts on the item: 0, 1, 2 set bits 5-6 of 0x08ebee06 to 1 and 0x08ebee08 to 2, 1 or 0 (a sub-screen request served by the editor loop; which screen is a hypothesis, low: recipe viewer / stored-deck operations); 3 reloads the editor lists (deck_reload_editor_lists) and 4 returns every deck card to the trunk (deck_return_deck_cards_to_trunk), both clearing the undo count 0x08ebf0e0 and closing the menu (sub-state 10); 5 starts the deck-name keyboard (ui_start_deck_name_input(0x08ebedc0, strTbl.bin string 0xd, 0)). Other results (including cancel) return to sub-state 0. Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x08ebee06, 0x08ebee08, 0x08ebf0e0, editor lists, menu record. Callers: 1 (ui_update_card_command_menu).

Opens the layout chooser: ui_open_command_submenu(title 0x45) resized to 0xb3 x 0x43 with 6-pixel margins and a custom item drawer at +0x100 (0x08ea7fe0); the current layout (ui_select_layout_index of pane count, narrow flag and the panes' list-layout flags) is stored at record +8 and pre-selected; record +0xa/+0xc keep the inactive pane number and its list kind. Returns nothing. Side effects: submenu window, record +8..+0xd. Callers: 1 (ui_handle_card_command_choice).

Sub-state 3: the eight layouts form two rows of four. Up/Down (pad +0xc 0x10/0x40) switch rows (index + 4 mod 8), Left/Right cycle inside the row; each move applies the layout at once (ui_apply_layout_choice) with sound 0x7a04. Confirm chooses (0x7a05); cancel marks the window cancelled and closes it (0x7a06). When the window has closed (+0xe9 == 6): if cancelled, the original layout (record +8) is restored and the menu returns to sub-state 0; otherwise, when the original layout was two-pane and the new mode is single-pane, the saved list (+0xc) gets its view reset (deck_reset_list_view), and the main window closes (sub-state 10). Returns nothing. Side effects: editor layout, panes, menu record, sounds. Callers: 1 (ui_update_card_command_menu).

Opens the trunk-option submenu: ui_open_command_submenu(title 0xb4, caption 0xb5, 3 items, label callback 0x08ea8224), width 0x108 (+100 and +0xf0), current choice marked by the bit mask 1 << save_get_setting_b0_bits6_7() at +0xd8; opens it. Returns nothing. Side effects: submenu window. Callers: 1 (ui_handle_list_tools_submenu).

Sub-state 4: when the trunk-option submenu returns, resets it; cancel (-2) reopens the list-tools submenu (sub-state 1); a choice is stored at record +0xe, the confirmation is opened (ui_open_trunk_option_confirm), sound 0x7a0c, sub-state 5. Returns nothing. Side effects: menu record, windows. Callers: 1 (ui_update_card_command_menu).

Reuses (or allocates, 0x120 bytes) the submenu window as a confirmation box: caption strTbl.bin string 0x34, width 0xf0, 3 choices (+0xca low nibble and +0xd4 = 3), font 0xc black, opened and centred on the 480 x 272 screen. Returns nothing. Side effects: submenu window. Callers: 1 (ui_handle_trunk_option_submenu).

Sub-state 5: when the confirmation returns, resets it; result 2 saves the chosen option (save_set_setting_b0_bits6_7(record +0xe)), rebuilds the trunk view (deck_reset_list_view(0x08ebed60), list 3), zeroes the scroll and cursor of any pane showing list 3 and the trunk's saved cursor (+0x18..+0x1c), frees the window and closes the menu (sub-state 10); 3 or cancel return to sub-state 0. Returns nothing. Side effects: save setting byte 0xb0 bits 6-7, trunk view, pane cursors, menu record. Callers: 1 (ui_update_card_command_menu).

column2: void * ui_draw_menu_separator_rules(void *list, void *vertices, short x, short y, short width)

Returns the advanced display-list pointer (the caller uses the value left by the final GE enable; Ghidra shows void). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_card_command_items).

Applies a layout from the layout chooser: ui_set_editor_layout(layout); when the editor was single-pane before and is now two-pane with pane 1 active, puts the list remembered by the chooser (menu record +0xc) back in pane 0 (ui_cycle_pane_list(0, list, 2)). Returns nothing. Side effects: as ui_set_editor_layout. Callers: 1 (ui_handle_layout_submenu).

Opens the card detail view with a 0x24-byte parameter block: resources 0x8007, 0x8009, 0x8024, 0x8011, 0x8010 at +0..+0x10 and heap *0x08ebf18c at +0x1c (ui_card_view_open), then loads the text of the card under the cursor (ui_load_cursor_card_text). Returns nothing. Side effects: card view state, text globals. Callers: 2 (deck_editor_init_state, deck_run_deck_tutorial).

Returns the view index under the cursor of pane `pane`: first visible index (+6) + column (+8) + row (+0xa) x columns (+0x22) in grid layout, first visible index + row in list layout. No side effects. Callers: 5 (ui_find_sort_group_index, deck_start_card_transfer, deck_start_card_move, ui_get_pane_cursor_entry, ...).

Returns the 6-byte list entry under pane `pane`'s cursor (list entries +4 indexed through the view array +0x10 at ui_get_pane_cursor_index(pane), which receives pane unchanged in a0), or NULL when the index is not below the list count (+0x14). No side effects. Callers: 9 (deck_editor_handle_browse_input, ui_set_editor_layout, deck_start_card_transfer, ui_load_cursor_card_text, ...).

Loads the card under the active pane's cursor into the detail globals: entry pointer 0x08ebf1b8, card id 0x08ebf1b0, image index 0x08ebf1b2; copies its description (card_db_get_description) into the buffer 0x08ebf238 flattening line breaks (ui_copy_text_flatten_newlines, size 0x314), measures it at font scale 0xc and stores the overflow beyond 0x4f40 (316 px in 1/64 units, minimum 0) in 0x08ebf1a4, zeroes the marquee offset 0x08ebf1a8 and the delay 0x08ebf1b4; in layout modes below 4 also sets the text scroller's card 0x08ebf1bc to the id and 0x08ebf1c4 to 0. With no entry (or id 0) clears them and sets 0x08ebf1bc to -1. Returns nothing. Side effects: the globals above.
