column2: void ui_cycle_pane_list(uint pane, ushort list, short dir)
column3: Changes the list shown in a pane: dir 1 next, 0 previous, any other value selects `list` directly. Single-pane modes cycle through lists 0-5 (pane 0 only), skipping 4, skipping 2, 4 and 5 for another owner's deck and 5 when the player has no save card-list items; two-pane modes cycle inside the pane's group of three (pane 0: 0-2, pane 1: 3-5), where another owner's deck skips list 2 in pane 0 and shows only list 3 in pane 1, and pane 1 skips list 5 without card-list items. When the list changes it stores the pane's cursor (ui_store_pane_cursors), points the pane at list record 0x08ebed00 + 0x20 x list, restores its saved scroll/column/row and re-clamps them (ui_place_pane_cursor), and replays the tab frames. Returns nothing. Side effects: pane record, list cursor fields, tab layout. Callers: 7 (deck_update_card_move, deck_animate_card_move_flight, deck_editor_handle_browse_input, ui_set_editor_layout, ...).

Returns the UTF-16 name of editor list 0-5: strTbl.bin (ui_deck_get_resource(0x8033)) string from the u16 table 0x08ebd578; for other values the static string at 0x08ebd584. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_set_card_move_label).

column2: void ui_place_pane_cursor(short keep_cursor, uint index, uint geometry, uint count, ushort *top, ushort *column, ushort *row)
column3: Clamps a pane's scroll and cursor to a list of `count` entries; geometry holds the columns in the low byte and the visible rows in the high byte (nothing happens with 0 columns). For count below 2 the first visible index *top becomes 0 (and column and row too unless keep_cursor). Otherwise *top is pulled back when the window runs past the end (to columns x (ceil(count / columns) - rows)) or set to 0 when everything fits, and *row is corrected by the change. The target index is `index`, or with keep_cursor = 1 the current cursor index clamped to count - 1, in which case nothing more changes while column and row are still inside the window. The index (clamped to count - 1) is then made visible: *top = 0 when its row is in the first screen, else columns x (index row - rows + 1); *column = index % columns and *row = index row - *top / columns. Returns nothing. Side effects: *top, *column, *row. Callers: 6 (ui_handle_filter_value_window, ui_run_text_search, ui_set_editor_layout, ui_cycle_pane_list, ...).

Saves pane cursors into the lists they show: for which != 1 pane 0 (list *0x08ebf1e0), for which != 0 pane 1 (list *0x08ebf20c): first visible index to list +0x18, column and row nibbles to +0x1c, the absolute cursor index to +0x1a and the column count (1 in list layout) to the low nibble of +0x1d. Returns nothing. Side effects: list records +0x18..+0x1d. Callers: 2 (ui_set_editor_layout, ui_cycle_pane_list).

Shows the deck editor's one-time hints when the editor was entered in mode 1 (deck_get_editor_entry_mode, the player's own deck): checks progress bytes 0-4 in order (save_get_progress_byte) and, for the first one not yet 2 whose condition holds, raises it to 2 (save_raise_progress_byte), stores the hint number 0-4 in the low nibble of 0x08ebee06 and, when hints are enabled (save_test_setting_b0_bit3), opens deck message 7 with that number (ui_open_deck_message) with sound 0x7a0c and returns. Conditions: 0 always (first visit); 1 the player has a free copy of a valid Fusion card (ids 0xe88-0x1f39, deck_count_free_card_copies_2, card_db_is_fusion); 2 progress byte 2 equals 1 (set elsewhere); 3 more than 0x95 free copies in total; 4 at least 300 (0x12c) free copies. When hints are off it moves on to the next check. Returns nothing. Side effects: save progress bytes 0-4, 0x08ebee06, message window. Callers: 3 (deck_run_deck_tutorial, deck_editor_init_state, ui_update_deck_message).

Starts the on-screen keyboard (ui_start_osk_input(buffer, title, 0x10, callback): at most 16 characters); on success (0) sets bit 6 of 0x08ebf1a0 (keyboard active) and clears bit 5 of 0x08ebf1dc (backdrop not yet captured). Returns nothing. Side effects: OSK state, 0x08ebf1a0, 0x08ebf1dc. Callers: 2 (ui_update_text_search_menu, ui_handle_deck_options_submenu).

Per-frame keyboard step from the editor draw: on the first frame captures the current screen as the keyboard backdrop (ui_capture_screen_backdrop) and sets bit 5 of 0x08ebf1dc; afterwards runs ui_update_osk_input(4) and clears the keyboard-active bit 6 of 0x08ebf1a0 when it reports completion. Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x08ebf1a0, 0x08ebf1dc, OSK state. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_deck_editor_screen).

Sub-screen runner for the card detail viewer, stepped by 0x08ebee02: 0 starts a fade-out (system_start_fade_out(1, black, 16 frames)); 1 when the fade is done opens the card viewer for the cursor card (ui_card_viewer_open(id, resource 0x800c, resource 0x8012)), sets its pack source to resource 0x8015, enables artwork selection and sets bit 0 of 0x08ebf1dc (the frame draw then shows the viewer); 2 updates the viewer until it finishes, then clears bit 0 and fades in; 3 when the fade is done resets the step to 0 and clears the request bit 4 of 0x08ebee06. Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x08ebee02, 0x08ebee06, 0x08ebf1dc, fades, card viewer state. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_update_subscreens).

Sub-screen runner for the help viewer, stepped by 0x08ebee02: 0 plays 0x7a09 and fades out; 1 when the fade is done opens help with resources 0x8014, 0x8034, 0x8035 and heap *0x08ebf188, the whole help (ui_help_open(0xd, ...)) when the topic byte 0x08ebee07 is -1, else that topic (ui_help_open_topic), and sets bit 3 of 0x08ebf1dc; 2 runs ui_help_update until it returns non-zero; 3 runs ui_help_close until it returns non-zero, then clears bit 3 and fades in; 4 when the fade is done resets the step and the topic to 0. Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x08ebee02, 0x08ebee07, 0x08ebf1dc, fades, help state, sound. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_update_subscreens).

column2: int ui_deck_find_resource(ushort id, void *table, int count)
column3: Binary search of `count` 12-byte resource records (u16 id at +0, sorted ascending) for id. Returns the record index or -1. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_deck_get_resource).

Resets the archive-load state 0x09e00880 (2 bytes cleared, then bit 0 = load may start) and sorts the 41 (0x29) 12-byte resource records at 0x08ebd84c by id (system_qsort with comparator 0x08eaa350). Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x09e00880, the resource table order. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_scene_enter).

Polls the editor's loading, stepped by bits 1-7 of 0x09e00880 while bit 0 is set: step 0 calls ui_deck_get_archive (which starts the deck/all_<l>.ehp load) and opens the card-art reader on a 0xbc1000-byte heap buffer (*0x08ebf19c, allocated on first use from heap *0x08ebf188) with card_db_open_cardh_cip(buffer, 0xbc1000, 0), storing the reader in 0x08ebf18c, advancing when the archive is available (the load callback also advances the step); step 1 waits for card_db_cip_is_ready(reader); step 2 clears the step and returns 1. Returns 1 when loading is complete, else 0. Side effects: 0x09e00880, 0x08ebf19c, 0x08ebf18c, heap, file loads. Callers: 2 (deck_editor_scene_enter, deck_run_deck_tutorial).

Returns the deck editor archive 0x08ebf190 once loaded. While it is NULL and bit 0 of 0x09e00880 allows a start, formats the name with the format at 0x08ebda38 ("deck/all_%c.ehp") and the language letter from "jegfis" (save_get_language), clears bit 0, gets the size with container_get_file_size(3, name), allocates it from heap *0x08ebf188 and starts container_load_file(3, name, buffer, size, ui_deck_on_archive_loaded, buffer); returns NULL until the load has completed. Side effects: 0x08ebf190, 0x09e00880, heap, asynchronous file load. Callers: 4 (deck_run_deck_tutorial, deck_run_recipe_viewer, ui_deck_get_resource, ui_deck_poll_archive_load).

Returns the archive member of resource `id`: finds the 12-byte record {u16 id, void *cache, char *format} in the 41-record table 0x08ebd84c (ui_deck_find_resource) and returns its cache; on first use (cache NULL, archive loaded) formats the name with the language letter from "jegfis" (ids 0x8036 and 0x8037 instead take the character at index 2 of the 8-byte string at 0x08ebda48, a constant index in the decompilation), looks it up with container_ehp_find_member and caches it; for id 0x8024 it also finds the matching .tmf member (the substring at 0x08ebda50 replaced by the 5 bytes at 0x08ebda58) and applies its flags (ui_ehf_apply_tmf_flags). Returns NULL for an unknown id or while the archive is not loaded. Side effects: the record's cache, tmf flags. Callers: 58 (ui_draw_table_icon_c, ui_open_trunk_option_confirm, ui_draw_search_filter_label, ui_draw_search_progress_bar, ...).

Completion callback of the deck/all_<l>.ehp load: when size > 0 binds the archive members (container_ehp_bind_with_callback(NULL, buffer)) and advances the load step (bits 1-7 of 0x09e00880); always sets bit 0 again. Returns size > 0. Side effects: archive binding, 0x09e00880. No direct caller (file-load callback passed by ui_deck_get_archive).

Opens the sort menu for the active pane's list: allocates the 0x18-byte sort record *0x09e00884 (+0 state, +2 focus bits 0-1, +4 saved view copy, +8 saved mode (bits 0-3) and order (bits 6-7), +0xc key window content bottom, +0x10 key window, +0x14 direction window), a key window (title strTbl.bin string 0xa8, 10 items 0x88 x 0x12, label callback 0x08eab298, centred at y 0x3a) and a direction window to its right (2 items, width fitted to strings 0x61/0x62 plus 0x19, capped at x 0x1d0, label callback 0x08eab2c8). Copies the list's view array (2 x count bytes) for cancel, saves the list's sort mode and order (list +0x16) and pre-selects them (key = mode - 1, direction = order), positions the direction window (ui_place_sort_direction_window), sets editor mode 0x08ebee00 = 3 and bit 0 of 0x08ebf1ac. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap, *0x09e00884, 0x08ebee00, 0x08ebf1ac. Callers: 2 (deck_editor_handle_tool_input, ui_handle_list_tools_submenu).

Per-frame step of the sort menu (editor mode 3): state 1 waits for the key window to close, then frees the menu (ui_close_sort_menu), returns to mode 0 and clears bit 0 of 0x08ebf1ac. State 0 keeps the direction window aligned with the selected key, updates the focused window (focus 0 key window: Right moves focus to the direction window and L/R (pad +4 0x300) flips the direction; focus 1: Left moves back), with sound 0x7a04. Whenever the key or direction selection changed it restores the saved view and re-sorts the list live (deck_sort_list_view(list, key + 1, direction)). When the focused window returns a result both windows start closing (state 1): cancel (-2) restores the saved view and the original mode/order bits of list +0x16; a choice re-sorts with the chosen key and direction. Returns nothing. Side effects: list view and sort bits, sort record, windows, 0x08ebee00, 0x08ebf1ac. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_update).

Resets both sort windows (+0x14, +0x10), frees them and the sort record from heap *0x08ebf188 and clears *0x09e00884. The saved view copy (+4) is not freed here. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap frees, 0x09e00884. Callers: 1 (ui_update_sort_menu).

Draws the sort menu: in two-pane layouts first shades the inactive pane (ui_draw_pane_shade(list, other pane, its list kind, 1)), then the key window (+0x10) and the direction window (+0x14) with ui_draw_list_window. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_editor_overlays).

Sets the direction window's y (+0x5a) so that it is vertically centred on the selected key item: key content top (record +0xc) + item height / 2 + selected index x item height - direction window height / 2. Returns nothing. Side effects: direction window +0x5a. Callers: 2 (ui_open_sort_menu, ui_update_sort_menu).

column2: void * ui_draw_table_icon_b(void *list, int kind, int x, int y)
column3: For kind != 0 draws a 17 x 17 icon described by the 6-byte record 0x08ebda60 + 6 x kind (u16 resource id, u8 u, u8 v) at (x, y), white, nearest filtering. Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged for kind 0 or a missing resource). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_pane_status).

column2: void * ui_draw_table_icon_c(void *list, int kind, int x, int y)
column3: Draws a 17 x 17 icon described by the 6-byte record 0x08ebdaa4 + 6 x kind (u16 resource id, u8 u, u8 v) at (x, y), white, nearest filtering (no special case for kind 0). Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged when the resource is missing). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_pane_status).

Opens the text search: allocates the 0x60-byte search record *0x09e00888 (+0 state, +2 search step, +4 focus bits 0-1, +6 UTF-16 query, +0x46 progress 0-1000, +0x48 extra height, +0x4c main window, +0x50 history window, +0x54 progress window, +0x58/+0x5c filter windows) and the main window at (0x5e, 0x38), 0x124 x 0x34, title strTbl.bin string 0xa5, caption 0x81, drawer ui_draw_search_input_box. When the active list is filtered (list +0x16 bits 6-9) the extra height is 0x27 and the filter windows are opened (ui_open_search_filter_windows). Grows the window to its content, opens the history window and sets editor mode 0x08ebee00 = 5. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap, *0x09e00888, 0x08ebee00. Callers: 1 (ui_handle_list_tools_submenu).

Per-frame step of the text search (editor mode 5) by state: 0 input: Triangle toggles the scope (ui_toggle_search_scope), Left/Right move the focus between the query box (0) and OK (2), Down on the box with a history window goes to state 1; confirm on OK chooses it (0x7a05, state 2), confirm on the box opens the keyboard on the query (ui_start_deck_name_input(query, strTbl.bin string 0x80, callback 0x08ead65c)); cancel marks the window cancelled and closes everything (0x7a06, state 3). 1 history list: a chosen entry copies the 0x40-byte history entry 0x08ebeee0 + 0x40 x n into the query and moves focus to OK; cancel or Up on the first entry returns to state 0. 2 waits for the window to finish its choose animation, then closes all windows (state 3). 3 when the main window has closed: if cancelled frees the menu and returns to mode 0, otherwise releases the windows and starts the search (state 4, step 0). 4 runs ui_run_text_search. Returns nothing. Side effects: search record, windows, 0x08ebee0a (through the scope toggle), 0x08ebee00, sounds. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_update).

Runs the search on the active pane's list, stepped by record +2: 0 with an empty query sets the list's filter field (list +0x16 bits 6-9) to 8 and goes to step 10; otherwise, when the list is filtered and the scope 0x08ebee0a is 1, clears the filter first (deck_reset_list_view); with entries it starts the search (deck_begin_text_search(list, query)), resets the progress, opens the progress window and goes to 1, without entries it begins and finishes at once and goes to 10. 1 waits for the progress window to open; 2 runs deck_step_text_search and stores its progress (per mille) at +0x46, moving on at 1000; 3 finishes (deck_finish_text_search), resets the pane cursor (ui_place_pane_cursor) and closes the progress window; 4 waits for it to close; then (also from 10) frees the menu, opens deck message 6 with the list's new count, plays 0x7a0c and returns to editor mode 0. Returns nothing. Side effects: list view and filter bits, pane cursor, search record, 0x08ebee00, message window. Callers: 1 (ui_update_text_search_menu).

Resets and frees the progress (+0x54) and history (+0x50) windows, releases and frees the two filter windows, resets and frees the main window (+0x4c) and finally the search record, clearing *0x09e00888. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap frees, 0x09e00888. Callers: 2 (ui_update_text_search_menu, ui_run_text_search).

Counts the non-empty entries of the 8 x 0x40-byte search history at 0x08ebeee0; with none returns 0. Otherwise allocates (or reuses) the history window (+0x50) and opens it below the main window (x + 6, y = content bottom + 0x11 + extra height), items 0xb0 x 0xe, one per entry, selection initialised past the last entry (no item highlighted), label callback 0x08ead38c. Returns 1, or 0 on allocation failure. Side effects: heap, history window. Callers: 1 (ui_open_text_search_menu).

Allocates (or reuses) the progress window (+0x54) and opens it at (0x8a, 0x70), 0xcc x 0x30, caption strTbl.bin string 0xa6 in white, no items, drawer ui_draw_search_progress_bar. Returns nothing (also on allocation failure). Side effects: heap, progress window. Callers: 1 (ui_run_text_search).

Opens the two windows that show the active filter inside the search dialog: window 0 at (main x + 0x15, main content bottom + 1), 0xfa x 0x27, drawer ui_draw_search_filter_label; window 1 at (main x + 0x2e, bottom + 0x13), 200 x 0x12, drawer 0x08eace20; each allocated (0x120 bytes) on first use at record +0x58/+0x5c. Returns 1, or 0 on allocation failure. Side effects: heap, filter windows. Callers: 1 (ui_open_text_search_menu).

Calls ui_update_list_window for each existing filter window (record +0x58, +0x5c; the window pointer is passed in a0, which Ghidra hides). Returns nothing. Side effects: window animation state. Callers: 1 (ui_update_text_search_menu).

Draws each existing filter window (record +0x58, +0x5c) with ui_draw_list_window(list_ptr, window), advancing *list_ptr. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_text_search_menu).
Starts the closing animation of each existing filter window (ui_list_window_start_close). Returns nothing. Side effects: window state. Callers: 1 (ui_update_text_search_menu).
Resets each existing filter window (ui_list_window_reset) without freeing it. Returns nothing. Side effects: window state. Callers: 2 (ui_update_text_search_menu, ui_close_text_search_menu).
Frees each existing filter window from heap *0x08ebf188 (the pointers at +0x58/+0x5c are left as they are). Returns nothing. Side effects: heap frees. Callers: 1 (ui_close_text_search_menu).

column2: void ui_draw_search_filter_label(void *list, int x, int y, int width)
column3: Drawer of the first search filter window: draws strTbl.bin string 0x84 in white at scale 0xc fitted to width at (x, y) (ui_search_filter_draw_text_fit_width_px) inside a font external list on `list`. Returns nothing. Side effects: font commands. No direct caller (window callback +0x100 set by ui_open_search_filter_windows).

column2: void ui_search_filter_draw_text_fit_width_px(int x, int y, int width, ushort *text)
column3: Pixel text wrapper that Ghidra shows as empty: per the font_px_wrappers family established from the instructions (ui.md), it shifts x, y and width left by 6 and tail-calls font_draw_text_fit_width. Returns nothing. Side effects: font commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_search_filter_label).

When the active list is filtered (list +0x16 bits 6-9 non-zero) and Triangle was pressed (pad +4 bit 0x1000), toggles the search scope 0x08ebee0a between 0 (search the filtered view) and 1 (clear the filter and search the whole list). column2: void * ui_draw_card_thumbnail(void *list, int x, int y, int shadow, uint color, ushort *entry, void *atlas_gim, void *alt_gim, int *artwork_table)

Callers pass resources 0x8001 (atlas), 0x8002 (alternative art) and 0x8032 (artwork table). Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged when the texture is NULL). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 6 (ui_draw_card_row_detailed, ui_draw_card_move, ui_draw_card_row_compact, ui_draw_card_grid, ...).

column2: void * ui_draw_card_entry_badges(void *list, short x, short y, ushort *entry, int show_count, int is_new, int show_item_mark, int show_key, int use_builtin, ushort marker, void *digit_gim, void *badge_gim, void *mark_gim)
column3: Draws the badges over a thumbnail (arguments 9-13 on the stack; callers pass textures 0x8009, 0x800a and 0x8006): when mark_gim is non-NULL and the entry comes from the owner's recipe (byte 5 bit 6), a 0x18 x 0x1f mark (texture 0xe9, 0xa5; the texture argument of this call is hidden in the decompilation, presumably mark_gim); with show_count the copy count (byte 4 & 0x7f, capped at 99) as two sprite digits at (x + 8, y + 0x15) when above 1; for an entry that is not a save card-list item (byte 4 bit 7 clear) with is_new set (callers pass save_get_card_state(id) == 1), a blinking 0x1d x 10 "new" sprite (texture 0, 100; frame counter bit 3) during the visible phase instead of the limit badge; otherwise the limit badge (12 x 12 at u = limit x 12, v 0x4c) when deck_get_card_limit(use_builtin, id) is below 3; then either a 10 x 10 card-list mark (0x25, 0x41) when show_item_mark and the entry is a card-list item, or the 12 x 12 marker (marker - 1) x 12 at v 0x58 for marker 1-3; finally, with show_key = 1 and a key card (byte 5 bit 5), the key icon (0x24, 0x4c). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 3 (ui_draw_card_row_detailed, ui_draw_card_row_compact, ui_draw_card_grid).

column2: void * ui_draw_card_frame_plate(void *list, uint xy, ushort width, uint frame, void *gim)

Width below 0x96 draws a 0x49 x 0xd plate (u = (c / 3) x 0x50, v = (c % 3) x 0xe + 0xc0); below 0xfa a 0xcb x 0x1f plate at v = c x 32; wider rows draw 0x68 + 0xbf pixels in two pieces. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands, VRAM. Callers: 1 (ui_update_deck_name_input).

column2: int ui_start_osk_input(ushort *buffer, ushort *title, int max_chars, void *callback)
column3: Starts Sony's on-screen keyboard: clears the 0x1b4-byte keyboard block at 0x09e0088c, inhibits soft reset, remembers buffer (0x09e00a38) and callback (0x09e00a3c), copies at most 24 units of buffer as the initial text to 0x09e00904 collapsing each '$$' pair to '$' (the game's text escape), and fills the sceUtilityOsk parameter block at 0x09e00890 (size 0x40, OSK language from the u16 table 0x08ebdb84 by game language, button swap from system_get_confirm_button, thread priorities 0x32/0x34/0x33, description = title, output buffer 0x09e00936, output length = max_chars). On a successful sceUtilityOskInitStart it starts a fade-out (type 2, colour 0xa0000000, 8 frames) and sets the state byte 0x09e0088c to 1; system_net_set_word_bafc(0) is called first. Returns the sceUtilityOskInitStart result (0 on success). Side effects: 0x09e0088c-0x09e00a3f, soft-reset inhibit, fade. Callers: 1 (ui_start_deck_name_input).

Per-frame keyboard step by the state byte 0x09e0088c: in states 1-3 draws the fade on GE layer `layer` (fade done moves 1 to 2 and 3 to 4); in states 1-2 polls sceUtilityOskGetStatus and, when the dialog finished (status 3, or status 2 with a non-zero sceUtilityOskUpdate), calls sceUtilityOskShutdownStart, copies the result 0x09e00936 back into the caller's buffer doubling every '$' when the dialog result (0x09e008ac) is 0, calls the callback(text, shutdown result), fades in and moves to 3. State 4 restores system_net_set_word_bafc(1) and soft reset and returns 1; state 0 returns 1. Returns 1 when the keyboard is finished, else 0. Side effects: keyboard block, caller's buffer, fades, callback. Callers: 1 (ui_update_deck_name_input).

Draws the editor screen: clears layer 0 to opaque black (colour, stencil, depth); unless bit 4 of 0x08ebf1dc is set, on layer 4 enables texturing and blending (alpha blend, no depth test) and draws either the captured backdrop (keyboard active, 0x08ebf1a0 bit 6, with the backdrop captured, 0x08ebf1dc bit 5) or the editor: ui_draw_editor_background, ui_draw_cursor_card_info(list, 0x08ebf1b0), ui_draw_editor_panes and ui_draw_editor_overlays; then runs the keyboard step (ui_update_deck_name_input) while the keyboard is active, or draws the screen fade on layer 5. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE drawing, keyboard state. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_deck_editor_frame).

Draws the editor's overlays by editor mode 0x08ebee00: in mode 0 (browse) and modes 6/7 the pulsing cursor frame (ui_draw_frame_box over the cursor rectangle 0x08ebf132-0x08ebf138 with resource 0x8006, flags = frame counter so bit 3 makes it pulse); modes 6 and 7 also place the controller guide next to the cursor (x from the pane and cursor, y 0xa2 or 0x36 depending on the cursor's half of the screen; fixed positions in layouts 4-7) and draw it with ui_draw_button_guide (buttons 0xf001, resource 0x8013 and strTbl.bin; alt 0 in mode 6 followed by ui_draw_sort_group_header, alt 1 in mode 7). Modes 1-5 draw the card move, command menu, sort menu, filter menu or text search. Finally the message window when a message kind is set (0x08ebf1a0 bits 7-14). Mode 6 is the hold-L scroll mode and 7 the hold-R tool mode (hypothesis, medium, from the guides drawn). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_deck_editor_screen).

Draws the editor's static layers in order, chaining the display list (passed through in a0, which Ghidra hides): background layout, list-tab layout, row stripes for the layout mode (low nibble of 0x08ebf1a0), header, pane status (icons, counts, scroll bars, tabs), frame-category counts and the frame-category bar. Sets the help content height 0x09e00b28 = text height (0x09e00b1c) + picture height (0x09e00b24) + 10. Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x09e00b28. Callers: 2 (ui_help_set_text, ui_help_set_picture).
